set: B: the key `step2-crank`, whole and in native crops, each beside the approved image

issues.where: the Continue button, lower right (native crop in set-B-02)
issues.what: in -a it is a light grey-silver pill with muted grey text; in -b it is a dark charcoal pill with bright white text, so it reads as enabled/primary instead of the quiet disabled control of -a
issues.fix: rebuild the button in the light grey-silver plastic of -a with subdued grey lettering and a faint highlight, not the dark metal shell

issues.where: the crank arm inside the crank panel (native crops 'the base of the crank' and 'the grip of the crank' in set-B-02)
issues.what: both images show the same state (3 of 10 meter segments lit), but the crank arm sits at different angles: about 30 degrees up from horizontal in -a versus about 60-70 degrees up in -b, and a viewer comparing the two sees two different moments
issues.fix: rotate -b's crank arm down to the shallow diagonal of -a so the grip points right and slightly up to the same spot on the panel

issues.where: the interior of the crank panel, top and sides, in 'the arrow' and 'the base of the crank' crops
issues.what: -b's panel interior carries a heavy dark inner shadow band along the top and stronger shading overall, making the well look deeper and dimmer than -a's light, open recess
issues.fix: thin and soften the inner shadow so the panel interior stays the pale grey-green of -a with only a shallow bevel shadow

issues.where: the orange crank grip in 'the grip of the crank' and 'the arrow' crops
issues.what: -b's grip is a dark rust-red orange, while -a's is a brighter, glossier candy orange
issues.fix: brighten the grip toward -a's vivid orange with a stronger top gloss highlight
